236. Fire of Destruction, Cruel Past (1)
Demon World, Solar Road.
Basset was indeed Ridolos' master. Despite the overwhelming difference in power and skills, he held out for a long time against Ridolos.
-"Protect Silky at all costs, Tilius. If you see no other way……then you and Misol must escape with Silky."
Before fighting with Ridolos, Basset urged as such, but Tilius and Misol did not choose to flee leaving him behind.
They could not bear to do so. Both Basset and Silky were individuals who could not be absent from
Bicepts, and more than anything, they judged that the power of both was necessary to catch Jito.
Even if they were to lose all other regular members, they had to save Basset and Silky. This was because they judged that they could have the hope of killing Jito and reclaiming the Demon World.
However, they were defeated.
Basset, having lost both arms, gasped for breath lying on the ruins, and Tilius and Misol were barely holding themselves up with their staggering legs.
On the other hand, Ridolos was just a bit tired, and if he wanted, he could finish off all of Bicepts in less than 5 minutes.
But Ridolos had been staring blankly at the sky since a while ago, as if he had lost his mind.
"The sun…… the sun of this land."
It was losing its light.
Jito summoning the core of the artificial sun through the abyss, and then destroying that core without hesitation. Nobody present expected this.
Even Ridolos was cutting down his old comrades to protect the artificial sun. He was confident that he would not lose to Bicepts, so the artificial sun was safe.
"What, what is happening…… exactly."
Darkness was quickly consuming Ridolos' sight.
Tears welled up helplessly, like a believer who lost his faith. If the sun disappears, the Demon World would turn into a terribly barren desert.
It would become a cursed land where life could not survive.
"Jin Runkandel will defeat Jito, Ridolos."
Tilius said. For a long while, Ridolos did not answer his words, but kept his blank gaze fixed on the sky.

"Didn't you see it too, how this place was drenched in gold for a moment. That light must have made the whole Demon World, perhaps even beyond that sky, bright for a moment. And that was the power of Jin Runkandel……."
"……So. You mean Jito summoned and destroyed the core of the artificial sun in his last stand?"
Even Zito, who was unable to properly handle the heyday of Paelito, was the one who suffered.

They thought it was absolutely impossible for Jin to defeat Zito without the help of the artificial sun, but now, everyone on Sun Road vividly felt the death of Zito. They knew it even if they didn't witness it directly.
“That must be it.”
“It's impossible. It's impossible...!”

“We've been doing meaningless things all along. Jin Runkandel defeated Zito without our help, the Biceps, or the artificial sun. But Biceps has finally achieved the goal of Zito's death. What about you? What's left for you, who betrayed us, who fought together for so long?”
Ridoros couldn't avoid the rising feeling of despair.
The only reason he betrayed Biceps was because he wanted to avoid the future where the Demon World loses the artificial sun and falls into darkness.
Kelriak had promised him such a future. He also promised to restore the Demon World to the beautiful land it was before Zito's reign.

“The artificial sun that you tried to block by killing us is gone. Kelriak failed to keep his promise with you. Can't any mortal survive without the sun? No way, Ridoros. We will survive even without light. We will be the light ourselves and resurrect the Demon World. No matter how long it takes!”
Thud!
Ridoros kneeled down, clutching his head as if falling. Tillyas's claim seemed to him an empty story.
“Unless the sun is reborn, the Demon World is over, Tillyas. Don't you really know that...? Look! Look at the ground under your feet. Can't you see the ground starting to boil?”
Just like what Jin and Elona experienced in Zito's residence, the land of Sun Road was also bubbling.
“Tillyas, not only here, but the entire Demon World will be boiling. Due to Zito's death and the destroyed artificial sun, the Demon World has now become a place where people can't live...”

“Find a place that's not boiling to settle down. If there isn't one, build high pillars and create homes for people to live on top. If there is no light, live by lighting a candle, and as time accumulates, you will rise again.”
“How is that different from destruction?”

“The difference is that there is hope. Ridoros, it's not too late yet. Kelriak is just using you. Come back to Biceps now. The Demon World needs people who can withstand this boiling land and establish a base.”
Tillyas sincerely thought so.
Although Ridoros betrayed them and blocked them, and slaughtered ordinary members in the process, the Demon World needed talents like Ridoros. To rise again.
But Ridoros shook his head.
“I... can't accept it. It's better to start taking away the ground from humans now. How the hell are we supposed to live in this hell?”

"Ridiculous! We have Jin Runkandel in the human world, who killed even Jito without the power of the artificial sun. That's not all. Even if all the forces in hell combined, it would be hard to conquer even a small island in the human world."
"Kelliac Ziphil will provide us with a place to live. Yeah, it's better this way. Living feeling the brilliant light of the real sun, not the artificial one, in the human world."
"You're out of your mind, Ridolros."
"Haha, how can you bear this reality without going mad? I have to go see Kelliac Ziphil...."
As Ridolros looked around, he felt the flow of a great force heading somewhere. It was the flow of Jito and the remnants of the artificial sun heading towards the Dokmaseong.
Ridolros intuitively knew that Kelliac Ziphil would acquire this power.
Now it was his turn to ask him. Did you know the artificial sun would turn out like this, Kelliac? Can you provide us demons with a place to live in the human world?
Tiliyas watched Ridolros, tense.
Fortunately, Ridolros turned away without killing the Visebs. Now that the artificial sun was gone, the life or death of the Visebs was no concern to him.
"Cough...!"
"Brother!"
"Lord Bassett!"
At Bassett's groan, Tiliyas and Misol approached him. Bassett spit out a metallic-sounding breath, vomiting blood.
About that time, Silkyah, who had been leading the regular members out of the battlefield, approached them as well.
"Jito is dead. What happened to Ridolros... Oh, Lord Bassett...!"
As soon as Silkyah saw Bassett, she tried to
heal him in surprise, but Bassett shook his head again.
"Don't waste your strength on me, Silkyah."
"But."
"I can't live anyway. Silkyah, from now on, evacuate the members to our headquarters... The headquarters should be able to withstand the boiling land for a while."
Silkyah closed her eyes tightly without saying anything. It was right to follow Bassett's words. With her ability, she could evacuate all the remaining about 800,000 regular members in an instant.
"Tiliyas."
"Speak, brother."

"From now on, take me and chase Ridolros... Jin Runkandel. Surely, he and his troops are also heading to Kelliac Ziphil. He may not be in perfect condition due to the fight with Jito, but he won't stand by and watch Kelliac get this power. We need to see firsthand what Kelliac will do with the remaining power of Jito and the artificial sun."
"......Understood."
Basset was prepared for death.
He planned to burn his remaining flame for the Demonic World one last time, as whatever Kelliak Ziphil would do from now on would certainly not be for the Demonic World.
"Silkia."
"Yes, Lord Basset."

"From now on, you are the leader of the Visepts. Take good care of the remaining ones. Remember, you have the potential to become a god. Misol, if neither Tilius nor I make it back, you must support Silkia."
Silkia and Misol nodded heavily.
"Let's go now, Tilius."
Tilius began to run, carrying Basset. They did not look back at Silkia and Misol, not even once.

Instead, they watched many demons, who were just beginning to break free from the brainwashing, along the way. They were the ones who were killing each other without reason just a moment ago under Zito's mind control.
They were sobbing, kneeling in front of the bodies of their colleagues, families, friends, and lovers they had killed. They were unable to escape, buried among the horribly torn and exploded bodies.

The demonic world, free from Zito's brainwashing, had indeed become hell, as it was named in the human world. The screams of those who had been unknowingly brainwashed and carried out horrific slaughter echoed throughout hell.
"We've all become sinners, Tilius. But since everyone is innocent, those who can live must live."
"Of course, brother."

"Jin Run Kandel. I have never met him myself... but he is certainly not someone who would use the demonic world like a chess piece and then discard it. From now on, the Visepts, no matter how shameless, must continue to reach out to him."
"It feels miraculous that we've met Jin Run Kandel and formed an alliance with the Bamal Union."
"I hope I can be of some help to him in the end, I hope so."

They ran, enduring the boiling, sticky hot land. Ridolros, driven mad, left traces without rest, and the two occasionally followed through the dimension doors that Ridolros used. Ridolros didn't care about their chase at all.
Eventually, after crossing five dimensional doors, they finally reached the Poisonous Demon Castle.
And the first thing that caught the eyes of Tilius and Basset was Ridolros, pierced by Kelliak's flame spear in his chest, flailing in mid-air.
"Kelliak! You promised to make the demonic world a proper world again!"
"Ridolros, if you wanted to say something to me, you should have come another day. Now is the time for me to welcome more important guests, and you shouldn't ruin this place with your noise."
"Argh!"

As the flame spear exploded, Ridolros was swallowed up. Kelliak, not giving a moment's glance to Ridolros's last moment or the Basset brothers, looked at two other people who had just arrived at the Poisonous Demon Castle.
"Welcome. Jin Run Kandel. And Lady Elona Ziphil."
